description: Element - audio plugin host (built from source)
pre_install: git clone --depth 1 --branch $version --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules https://github.com/kushview/element $src; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'git clone failed' }
cmake --build "$src\build" --config Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'cmake build failed' }
cmake --install "$src\build" --config Release --prefix $dir; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'cmake install failed' }
notes: Built from source on install (can take a while): needs Visual Studio Build Tools (C++ workload).
